catalog.summary: Progress bar or ring, known or indeterminate.

edge.box: edge-start stands on the block-start edge of the nearest positioned box and edge-end on its block-end edge, the whole inline size of that box. The box is the placer's: app-shell and page-header each render one as their progress part
edge.line: the bar covers the line the edge already draws when the box is a frame with no border of its own, as both hosts' progress parts are; inside a bordered box it stands just inside the border. No track, no stop indicator, no radius: the box's corners clip the bar. hideLabel is implied, as under page
edge.motion: it grows out of the edge it stands on and collapses back into it: a clip-path inset from the edge, never a scale, because the root holds the label, entering on --slotted-duration-medium and --slotted-easing-enter through @starting-style, leaving on --slotted-duration-short and --slotted-easing-exit with display transitioned as a discrete property. page shares it, as the edge bar of the viewport
edge.forcedColors: the track keeps no outline of its own: the host already draws the edge in a system color, and a second outline would be a second line
